ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points C and E are two points on the line segment AB, point D is the midpoint of line segment AB, and AB = 6, CD = 1. If AE : EC = 1 : 3, find the length of EC.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point D is the midpoint of line segment AB, and AB$=6$,\\
thus AD$=\frac{1}{2}$AB$=3$,\\
since CD$=1$, thus AC$=$AD$+$CD$=4$,\\
since AE:EC$=1:3$, thus EC$=\frac{3}{1+3}\times 4=\boxed{3}$.
